stance_basis: listed under commenters who responded without substantive comments
summary: The Federal Highway Administration is listed as one of the commenters on the draft environmental impact statement for the MY 1979 Average Fuel Economy Standards for Nonpassenger Automobiles. It responded without substantive comments, indicating no specific objections or support for the proposed action. No positions, concerns, or recommendations are attributed to the agency in the document window.
complaint_summary: The Federal Highway Administration is listed among commenters on the draft EIS who responded without substantive comments, grouped under the Department of Transportation entry in the List of Commenters.
